The big idea

At the heart of every galaxy is a singularity. The smallest point in the universe — with the strongest pull.

It doesn’t chase. It doesn’t shout. Everything simply comes together around it, and finds its orbit. We built a bank like that.

Switch in 7 working days

Strong gravitational pull.

Products good enough to switch for, and a switch that does the heavy lifting for you. Pull even brings your other banks into the same view.

  1. 1

    Step 1: Open Orbit

    Apply in the app. Arc explains each step in plain English, and a real person is there if you’d rather talk.

  2. 2

    Step 2: Choose your switch date

    We move your balance, salary and Direct Debits across, and redirect anything still heading to your old account.

  3. 3

    Step 3: Welcome to the singularity

    Within 7 working days, everything’s in orbit — in one place, on your terms.

Strong pull. Zero lock-in.

Products good enough to pull you in — and honest enough never to lock you in. No penalties on easy access, and you can leave whenever you like.

Orbit — current account

Your money, your orbit.

Your balance sits at the centre. Moons — pots for bills, holidays and a rainy day — orbit around it. You set the rules; we help it grow.

Meet Arc — your AI money companion

Candour: 100%. Always.

Arc is named for the arc of light around the singularity — and your financial story arc. It’s an AI, it always says so, and it tells you the true thing first.

Personality dials

Try them
Candour100% · Locked

Non-negotiable. Fees, risks and limits come first — always.

40%

A wink, not a joke. Wit drops to 0% automatically for bereavement, hardship, fraud, complaints and any sign you need extra care — with a warm handover to Mission Control.

At 0%, this is how Arc sounds in hard moments: clear, kind and to the point.

Detail

Arc AI

Your AI money companion

Illustrative
  1. You:

    Can I afford a weekend in Edinburgh next month?

  2. Arc:

    Calculating trajectory…

    Short answer: yes, comfortably. After rent and bills you’ll have about £640 left in orbit next month. A typical weekend — train plus two nights — runs £350–£450. Want me to start an ‘Edinburgh’ Moon and move £100 a week into it?

Arc is an AI and always says so. It won’t give regulated financial advice.

What Arc can do

  • Answer balance and spending questions with Lens
  • Move money between your Moons
  • Set saving rules
  • Explain products in plain English
  • Run “Is this a scam?” checks
  • Prepare a switch
  • Host your weekly Look Up check-in

What Arc won’t do

  • Give regulated financial advice
  • Push products
  • Guess when it’s unsure
  • Hide fees
  • Pretend to be human
